definition.title: Artifact allocation inspection
definition.briefing: Defeat the wounded enemy commander, then inspect a campaign survivor deployed beside the native artifact.
definition.failureText: The commander was lost during inspection.

objectives.text: Keep the inspection window open for 120 seconds.
